blocks.en: We have thus replaced the partial differential equation \eqref{eq:harmonic-dirichlet-boundary-integral-problem} by the equivalent integral equation \eqref{eq:dirichlet-double-layer-boundary-integral-equation}. This has two advantages. As we shall see in Chapter~\ref{chap:linear-elliptic-equations}, it is fairly easy to develop an existence theory for integral equations such as \eqref{eq:dirichlet-double-layer-boundary-integral-equation}. Moreover, a numerical approach based on \eqref{eq:dirichlet-double-layer-boundary-integral-equation} rather than \eqref{eq:harmonic-dirichlet-boundary-integral-problem} has the advantage of working with a problem in a lower space dimension, which translates into fewer gridpoints. Indeed, there is an extensive literature on ``boundary-element methods'' for Laplace\textquotesingle s equation as well as for the Stokes equation.
blocks.zh: 这样就把偏微分方程 \eqref{eq:harmonic-dirichlet-boundary-integral-problem} 替换为等价的积分方程 \eqref{eq:dirichlet-double-layer-boundary-integral-equation}. 这有两个优点. 如将在 Chapter~\ref{chap:linear-elliptic-equations} 中看到的, 对 \eqref{eq:dirichlet-double-layer-boundary-integral-equation} 这样的积分方程建立存在性理论相当容易. 此外, 与基于 \eqref{eq:harmonic-dirichlet-boundary-integral-problem} 的数值方法相比, 基于 \eqref{eq:dirichlet-double-layer-boundary-integral-equation} 的方法处理的是空间维数较低的问题, 因而所需网格点较少. 事实上, 关于 Laplace 方程及 Stokes 方程的 ``边界元方法'' 已有大量文献.
